name: Anastasia
source: Trained from a young age and showed prodigal skill as one of the most skilled in combat of her family, House of the Sanguine Rose. After the king dies with no heir, and seeing her house and her family's namesake skilled fighters begin to stagnate she decides to take the empty throne for herself.
